format: English (NA/EU/OC/LATAM/ME) Standard Regulation, Blocks 2-5 legal (Apr 1 2026 - Mar 31 2027); newest legal booster OP17 (released 2026-08-28); banned/restricted list effective 2026-10-12 (OP14-020 banned)
countingMethod: Sum of final placings 1-8 per leader card ID across 29 Limitless-platform online Standard events (24+ players, decklists published) from 2026-08-30 to 2026-11-28, written by npm run meta:update. Skipped: Extra Regulation events, events with a card not in the card snapshot (not yet released in English), and decklists that break the current Standard list (banned, rotated, over a restricted limit). metaShare = percent of all 2026 counted decklists. Archetypes: the top 12 leaders by top-8 count, plus any earlier archetype (kept until a person removes it).
tierNote: tier (onepiece.gg) is null for every archetype: onepiece.gg robots.txt disallows anthropic-ai and Claude-Web, so its pages were not opened. tierOpmetagame is from https://opmetagame.com/tier-list/ (OP-17 meta, October 2026), mapped by leader name and color.

archetypes.handAdded: Added by hand 2026-11-28 (M11 Track C). OP18 Leader with no top-8 result yet (best placing 28th of 121), so the three lists are the best-placed lists that need no card the simulator has not scripted yet: 28th of 121, 28th of 60, 100th of 105 (record 0-2). Better-placed Franky lists (34th of 95, 3-2; 69th of 105, 1-2) run Charlotte Pudding OP08-067 and other block-2 cards that are held. In the four cached OP18-era events (2026-11-16 to 11-23, 379 decks) it is 2.9% of decks. meta:update replaces the lists as top-8s arrive. The 2026-11-28 refresh found its first top-8 list (2nd, [OP18] ChinoizeCup #141 WEDNESDAY, 2026-11-25), which runs Charlotte Pudding OP08-067 (block 2, held); the three playable lists are kept by hand until that card is scripted (BACKLOG §15).
